summary: Frontend-only testing of new Academy destination, Plaza Academy building + cuckoo, ceremony-only Stage (#/rank-hall), at 1920x800 and phone landscape 844x390. All 6 requested feature groups PASS functionally. One visible design bug: the decorative floor line on #/academy is drawn over the room cards.

issues: The 3px dark 'floor' line (AcademyPage.js line 167, absolute top:55%) paints ON TOP of the white Card. The Card is not positioned (no position/z-index), so the absolutely-positioned line stacks above it. You can see it cut through quest row 2, the album sleeves, and the 'Next: Tadpole' meter. Fix: add 'relative z-10' to the Card (or give the content wrapper position:relative; zIndex:1).
Print report modal opens scrolled so the top row (Print/close buttons) sits partly above the viewport edge. Minor.
The fixed fullscreen button (bottom-right) slightly overlaps the right edge of the album card (card right=777px, button ~785px+). Cosmetic only.

action_items: AcademyPage.js: make the Card (or the motion.div room wrapper) position:relative with a z-index above the floor line so the line no longer crosses the card content.
Optional: academy-start-class and rank-hall-bow use infinite scale animations, so Playwright needs force=True to click them ('element is not stable'). Real users are not affected.
critical_code_review_comments: AcademyPage MyAlbum builds the track list with useMemo(..., []). This is fine for now because the page remounts on navigation, but the list won't update if storage changes while the page is open.
StickerBookPage reads print=1 only when state first initializes, and the hash keeps print=1 after the modal is closed, so a refresh re-opens the modal. Consider removing the param after it opens.
Unrelated pre-existing warning: duplicate React key warning on #/simon-says?quest=easy ('Encountered two children with the same key').
